GetSourceStartTime.doc: Returns the start time position of the media pool clip in the timeline clip

GetStart.doc: Returns the start frame position on the timeline. Returns fractional frames if subframe_precision is True

GetStereoConvergenceValues.doc: Returns a dict (offset -> value) of keyframe offsets and respective convergence values

GetStereoLeftFloatingWindowParams.doc: For the LEFT eye -> returns a dict (offset -> dict) of keyframe offsets and respective floating window params

GetStereoRightFloatingWindowParams.doc: For the RIGHT eye -> returns a dict (offset -> dict) of keyframe offsets and respective floating window params

GetTakeByIndex.doc: Returns a dict with take info for specified index

GetTakesCount.doc: Returns the number of takes in take selector, or 0 if the clip is not a take selector

GetTrackTypeAndIndex.doc: Returns a list of two values that correspond to the TimelineItem's trackType (string) and trackIndex (int) respectively

GetType.doc: Returns the type of the item: 'video', 'audio', 'generator' or 'transition'

GetUniqueId.doc: Returns a unique ID for the timeline item

GetUseTimelineForOutputBlanking.doc: Gets the flag to use the timeline's output blanking for the clip.

GetVersionNameList.doc: Returns a list of all color versions for the given versionType (0 - local, 1 - remote)

GetVoiceIsolationState.doc: Returns the Voice Isolation State as a dict {isEnabled, amount}, of the timelineItem

ImportFusionComp.doc: Imports a Fusion composition from given file path by creating and adding a new composition for the item

LoadBurnInPreset.doc: Loads user defined data burn in preset for clip when supplied presetName (string).

LoadFusionCompByName.doc: Loads the named Fusion composition as the active composition

LoadVersionByName.doc: Loads a named color version as the active version. versionType: 0 - local, 1 - remote

PerformMulticamSmartSwitch.doc: Performs Multicam SmartSwitch on the multicam TimelineItem using the given smartSwitchSettings

RemoveFromColorGroup.doc: Removes the clip from its ColorGroup

RenameFusionCompByName.doc: Renames the Fusion composition identified by oldName

RenameVersionByName.doc: Renames the color version identified by oldName and versionType (0 - local, 1 - remote)

ResetAllNodeColors.doc: Resets node color for all nodes in the active version of the clip.

SelectTakeByIndex.doc: Selects a take by index, 1 <= idx <= number of takes

SetCDL.doc: Sets CDL values on the node. Keys of map are: 'NodeIndex', 'Slope', 'Offset', 'Power', 'Saturation'

SetClipColor.doc: Sets the item color based on the colorName (string)

SetClipEnabled.doc: Sets clip enabled based on argument

SetColorOutputCache.doc: Sets caching to enabled or disabled. Equivalent to clip context menu action 'Render Cache Color Output'

SetFades.doc: Sets the fade durations (in frames) for the item's video or audio fader from a dict {FadeIn, FadeOut}

SetFusionOutputCache.doc: Sets caching to auto, enabled or disabled. Equivalent to clip context menu action 'Render Cache Fusion Output'

SetName.doc: Sets the clip's name to name.

SetOutputBlanking.doc: Sets the output blanking for the clip. Accepts a dictionary with keys 'Top', 'Bottom', 'Left' and 'Right'. The values are in pixels.

SetProperties.doc: Sets the item properties with specified dict of property keys and values. See README.md section 'Looking up Timeline item properties'.

SetSourceAudioChannelMapping.doc: Sets source audio channel mapping from a JSON string.

SetUseTimelineForOutputBlanking.doc: Sets the flag to use the timeline's output blanking for the clip.

SetVoiceIsolationState.doc: Sets Voice Isolation state of the timelineItem to the given VoiceIsolationState of {isEnabled (bool), amount (int)}. amount is in range of [0, 100].

UpdateMarkerCustomData.doc: Updates customData (string) for the marker at given frameId position. CustomData is not exposed via UI and is useful for scripting developer to attach any user specific data to markers

UpdateSidecar.doc: Updates sidecar file for BRAW clips or RMD file for R3D clips

autoImportSourceClipsIntoMediaPool.doc: Import source clips into media pool (default: True)

ignoreFileExtensionsWhenMatching.doc: Ignore file extensions when matching (default: False)

importMultiChannelAudioTracksAsLinkedGro.doc: Import multi-channel audio tracks as linked groups (default: False)

insertWithOffset.doc: Insert with timecode offset, e.g. '00:00:00:00' (applies when insertAdditionalTracks is False)

linkToSourceCameraFiles.doc: Link to source camera files (default: False)

sourceClipsFolders.doc: Media Pool folders to search for source clips

sourceClipsPath.doc: Filesystem path to search for source clips if media is inaccessible

channelNumber.doc: For AUDIO_SYNC_WAVEFORM mode: channel offset, 1 to min channel count across input clips (default: 1)

charsPerLine.doc: Max characters per line, 1 to 60 (default: 42, varies by preset/language)

gap.doc: Gap between subtitles in frames, 0 to 10 (default: 0)

NodeIndex.doc: Target node index, 1 <= NodeIndex <= total number of nodes

Offset.doc: RGB offset values as space-separated string, e.g. '0.4 0.3 0.2'

Power.doc: RGB power values as space-separated string, e.g. '0.6 0.7 0.8'

Slope.doc: RGB slope values as space-separated string, e.g. '0.5 0.4 0.2'

Clip Color.doc: Clip color, e.g. 'Orange', 'Teal'. Empty when no color is set

Date Added.doc: Date clip was added to media pool

Flags.doc: Flag colors assigned to the clip

Usage.doc: Number of times clip is used in timelines

JobStatus.doc: 'Complete', 'Cloning', 'Cancelled', or 'Failed'. If no clone job has been started yet, this is 'Complete'

syncMode.doc: Media sync mode of the cloud project

EstimatedTimeRemaining.doc: Time remaining to complete subtitle creation in seconds (set during analysis)

IpAddress.doc: IP address of the PostgreSQL server, e.g. '127.0.0.1' (optional)

FileName.doc: Output file name pattern (default: '%{Source Name} Deblur')

UseMarkInMarkOut.doc: Only process mark in/out range (default: True)

UseMoreGpuMemory.doc: Use more GPU memory for processing (default: False)

AnalysisSpeed.doc: Analysis speed in fps (set during analysis)

EstimatedTimeRemaining.doc: Estimated time remaining in seconds (set during analysis)

Expiry.doc: Valid ISO 8601 string (default: no expiry if empty value)

EndIndex.doc: End frame index for image sequences (optional)

FilePath.doc: File path (supports %0Nd frame pattern for image sequences)

StartIndex.doc: Start frame index for image sequences (optional)

importSourceClips.doc: Import source clips into media pool (default: True, not valid for DRT)

sourceClipsFolders.doc: Media Pool folders to search for source clips if importSourceClips is False

sourceClipsPath.doc: Filesystem path to search for source clips if media is inaccessible

timelineName.doc: Name for the created timeline (not valid for DRT import)

in.doc: Record frame relative to timeline start, e.g. 10

out.doc: Record frame relative to timeline start, e.g. 320

customData.doc: Custom data field not exposed via UI

createBinForSourceClips.doc: Create bin for source clips (default: True)

frameRate.doc: Frame rate, e.g. 23.976 (default: project timeline frame rate)

name.doc: Clip name (auto-generated from first clip if omitted)

splitAtGaps.doc: Split at gaps (angleSyncMode=MULTICAM_ANGLE_SYNC_AUDIO only, default: False)

normalizationMode.doc: Mode name from GetNormalizeAudioModes() (default: 'Sample Peak Program')

creationDate.doc: Creation date in ISO 8601 format, e.g. '2024-06-15T09:30:00+05:30'

lastModifiedDate.doc: Last modified date in ISO 8601 format, e.g. '2024-06-15T09:30:00+05:30'

colorSpaceOutputToneLuminanceMax.doc: Max output luminance in nits, e.g. '1000'

graphicsWhiteLevel.doc: Graphics white level in nits, e.g. '200'

hdrMasteringLuminanceMax.doc: Mastering luminance max in nits, e.g. '1000'

inputDRTSatRolloffLimit.doc: Input saturation rolloff limit in nits, e.g. '10000'

inputDRTSatRolloffStart.doc: Input saturation rolloff start in nits, e.g. '10000'

limitSubtitleCaptionDurationSec.doc: Max caption duration in seconds, e.g. '3'

nodeStackLayers.doc: Number of node stack layers, e.g. '1'

outputDRTSatRolloffLimit.doc: Output saturation rolloff limit in nits, e.g. '10000'

outputDRTSatRolloffStart.doc: Output saturation rolloff start in nits, e.g. '10000'

perfAutoRenderCacheAfterTime.doc: Idle time in seconds before caching starts, e.g. '5'

perfProxyMediaMode.doc: '0' disabled, '1' when available, '2' when source not available

rcmPresetMode.doc: 'SDR' or 'HDR' when isAutoColorManage is '1', otherwise e.g. 'SDR Rec.709' or 'Custom'

timelineFrameRate.doc: Returned as a number, e.g. 23.976. Set as a string, e.g. '23.976' or '29.97 DF'

timelineSampleRate.doc: Audio sample rate in Hz, e.g. '48000'

EnableUpload.doc: Enable direct upload for supported web presets (default: False)

EstimatedTimeRemainingInMs.doc: Time remaining to render (set for rendering jobs)

JobStatus.doc: 'Rendering', 'Render Complete', 'Render Failed', 'Render Cancelled', 'Upload Pending', 'Uploading', 'Upload Completed', 'Upload Failed', 'Upload Cancelled', 'Inactive' or 'Unexpected'

TimeTakenToRenderInMs.doc: Time taken to render (set on completion)

AlphaMode.doc: 0 = Premultiplied, 1 = Straight (set when ExportAlpha is True)

EstimatedTimeRemainingInMs.doc: Time remaining to render, set for 'Rendering' jobs

JobStatus.doc: Current status, one of 'Ready', 'Ready for background render', 'Rendering', 'Complete', 'Cancelled', 'Background Render Cancelled', 'Failed', 'Ready to remotely render' or 'Remote Render Cancelled'

TimeTakenToRenderInMs.doc: Time taken to complete render, set for 'Complete' jobs

AddFrameHandles.doc: Frame handles count >= 0 (ignored if UseFullExtents is True)

AudioFormat.doc: Audio format, e.g. 'mp3' (only if ExportVideo is False)

DataBurnIn.doc: Data burn-in preset, e.g. 'Same as project', 'None'

SelectAllFrames.doc: Select all frames (MarkIn/MarkOut ignored when True)

CurrentClipIndex.doc: Index of the clip being analyzed (set during analysis)

EstimatedTimeRemaining.doc: Time remaining to complete analysis in seconds (set during analysis)

TotalClips.doc: Total clips to analyze (set during analysis)

AnalysisSpeed.doc: Analysis Speed in fps (set during analysis)

EstimatedTimeRemaining.doc: Time remaining to complete smart reframe in seconds (set during analysis)

editChangeDelay.doc: Edit change delay in seconds, 0.0 to 2.0 (default: 0.3)

isAutoDetectWideAngle.doc: Auto-detect wide angle from analysis (default: True)

isUseWideAngleForIntroOutro.doc: Use wide angle for intro/outro (default: True)

isUseWideAngleForSilence.doc: Use wide angle for silence (default: True)

minEditDuration.doc: Minimum edit duration in seconds, 0.5 to 10.0 (default: 1.0)

switchOnVideoOnly.doc: Switch on video only, not supported in adaptive/source mode (default: False)

wideAngleID.doc: Wide angle name, or 'None' to disable (used when isAutoDetectWideAngle is False)

AddToTimeline.doc: Add generated audio to timeline (default: False)

AudioTrack.doc: Target audio track number (0 = new track)

CustomVoiceFile.doc: Full path to custom voice file (required when VoiceModel is 'Custom Voice')

Percentage.doc: Speed in percentage, e.g. 110.0 (0.0 = freeze frame)

PitchCorrection.doc: Pitch correction of linked audio (default: clip's existing state)

CompositeMode.doc: See README.md section 'Looking up Timeline item properties'.

RetimeAndScalingEnabled.doc: Enable/disable Retime and Scaling filter section

timelineFrameRate.doc: Returned as a number, e.g. 23.976. Set as a string, e.g. '23.976' or '29.97 DF'

CompletionPercentage.doc: Completion percentage (set while transcription is in progress)

CurrentClipIndex.doc: Index of the clip being analyzed (set while transcription is in progress)

EstimatedTimeRemaining.doc: Time remaining to complete transcription in seconds (set while transcription is in progress)

TotalClips.doc: Total clips to analyze (set while transcription is in progress)

speaker.doc: Speaker name if detected, None otherwise

text.doc: Concatenated text of all words in segment; '(...)' denotes silence

alignment.doc: Placement relative to the edge: 'left', 'center' or 'right'

position.doc: Edge of the item to attach the transition to: 'start' or 'end'
